source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the likely remove-prune wordplay while preserving union, fruit, and increased yield; the first verb can also mean lift up.
key_decisions.before: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he removes, and every branch that bears fruit he prunes so that it may bear more fruit.
key_decisions.after: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he removes, and every branch that bears fruit he prunes so that it may bear more fruit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Every branch in me not bearing fruit he takes away, and every one bearing fruit he prunes so that it may bear more fruit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the clean-prune word relationship and the cleansing agency of Jesus’ word.
key_decisions.before: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
key_decisions.after: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the identities, reciprocal abiding, abundant fruit, and complete dependence.
key_decisions.before: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever remains in me and I in them bears much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.
key_decisions.after: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever remains in me and I in that person bears much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one remaining in me, and I in him, this one bears much fruit, because apart from me you are not able to do anything.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves condition, sequence, passive gathering, fire, and destruction imagery.
key_decisions.before: If anyone does not remain in me, they are thrown out like a branch and wither. Such branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned.
key_decisions.after: If anyone does not remain in me, that person is thrown out like a branch and withers. Such branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If anyone does not remain in me, he is thrown out like a branch and dries up, and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the comparison, self-giving life, and friendship.
key_decisions.before: No one has greater love than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
key_decisions.after: No one has greater love than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Greater love than this no one has, that someone should lay down his life for his friends.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the slave-friend contrast, differing knowledge, and revelation received from the Father.
key_decisions.before: I no longer call you slaves, because a slave does not know what the master is doing. I have called you friends because I have made known to you everything I heard from my Father.
key_decisions.after: I no longer call you slaves, because a slave does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything I heard from my Father.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No longer do I call you servants, because the servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because everything that I heard from my Father I have made known to you.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the remembered saying and both parallel conditions without forcing the second into irony.
key_decisions.before: Remember the word I told you: ‘A slave is not greater than the master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
key_decisions.after: Remember the word I told you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the counterfactual, culpability, present lack of pretext, and repeated sin.
key_decisions.before: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
key_decisions.after: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Advocate and Spirit titles, Jesus’ sending, origin from the Father, procession, and testimony.
key_decisions.before: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.
key_decisions.after: When the Advocate comes—the one I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—he will testify about me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, that one will bear witness about me.
